name: Undetectable Alignment
body:
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 363
School abjuration; Level alchemist 2, antipaladin 2, bard 1, cleric 2, inquisitor 2, investigator 2, mesmerist 1, oracle 2, paladin 2, psychic 2, skald 1, warpriest 2
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature or object
Duration 24 hours
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)
Description
An undetectable alignment spell conceals the alignment of an object or a creature from all forms of divination.
